gwt.given: grainType = "orders" is configured with a Query contract, the supplied grain state has State = null when ReadStateAsync begins, and the configured read query returns no row for the supplied key
gwt.then: the read query maps into a new default TModel instance (because State was null), and since no row is returned grainState.State is replaced with a new instance — created by TModel's static IActivator<TModel> factory when TModel implements IActivator<TModel>, otherwise a default TModel whose shard key is set from the grain id through the shard-setting delegate cached for the state name "orders" and the state type TModel — and RecordExists is set to false
